pages.text: Allah tested His servant Ayyub (peace be upon him) with harm that touched him, and he lost his family and his wealth. And Ayyub was patient with the trial.
Ayyub called out to his Lord: ﴿أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّـٰحِمِينَ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'Harm has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.'
Allah answered his prayer. Cool water sprang up for him from the ground, to drink and to wash in, and the harm left him.
Allah lifted the trial from him and gave him back his family, and as many again with them. It was a mercy from Allah, and an example for everyone who is patient with a trial.
